The demo PDF contains three specific challenges: descriptions wrapping to new lines, transactions split across pages, and negative values formatted with accounting parentheses.
Overlapping columns in a PDF's text layer can cause numbers to fuse into incorrect values, a problem that cannot be solved by parser logic.

A test using an image-only PDF processed through Google Gemini vision successfully demonstrated the end-to-end path of scanning, OCR, parsing, and reconciliation.

While extraction has been proven on a real 86-row card statement, no real statement featuring a balance column has undergone reconciliation yet.
